# First independent creation: supported roundtrip acceptance

This complements the direct library acceptance with one continuous player
journey in the existing PI Desktop renderer. It does not introduce a second
editor or substitute generated fixtures for catalog assets.

## Required journey

1. Create a blank creation world using the ordinary New World form. Use its
   actual newly selected conversation and an isolated profile with no model
   connection.
2. Select the approved Pomeranian from the real local catalog. Prepare, check,
   and explicitly apply its exact asset reference using the library detail.
3. Use the existing **Place here** action on actual sampled ground to add a
   stock tree. Select the checked tree from Recent results. Change its scale
   and color with the ordinary object editor and wait for native checking and
   formal adoption.
4. Save and cold reopen. The exact catalog instance and edited tree must both
   remain, along with inventory and reward ledgers.
5. Publish the formal world with the explicit saved-progress choice and export
   its world template using the ordinary forms and isolated native picker.
6. Start a separate empty profile. Import only the exported ZIP, create a new
   world, play, save, and cold reopen. Assert the same edited tree and catalog
   instance survive, without copying the author's profile or source database.

## Evidence and boundaries

The driver is `tests/first-creation-roundtrip-native.mjs`. Record the actual
compiled main hash, Core/host binary hashes, optional sealed package identity,
operation receipts, native observations and snapshots, world captures, normal
shutdown audits, and per-session observed model calls. The result must report
zero observed model calls for this direct journey.

The catalog companion is retained as its actual installed model. The scale and
color change belongs to an ordinarily placed stock tree, which the current
editor supports. This acceptance does **not** claim arbitrary GLB recoloring,
editing catalog component internals, or AI generation performance.

Use offscreen, unfocused, non-focusable Electron windows with Pointer Lock
disabled. Page scripts invoke real React handlers/forms; no physical input or
Playwright mouse/keyboard methods are allowed. Actual native movement is sent
through the bounded headless native exploration service. Preserve cancelled or
failed runs as diagnostics. A fresh profile on a developer machine is not a
clean Windows machine or a human participant study.

An explicit `CRAFTMINE_CREATION_OUTPUT_ROOT` can select a short absolute
`test-results` directory to stay within managed engine path limits. Every run
still creates its own `desktop-native-*` directory and validates both profile
markers. The cancel file and SIGINT/SIGTERM stop the driver's waiting loop;
normal client shutdown remains required.

## Oversized catalog geometry

An otherwise static catalog mesh over the picker allocation limit must not
disable a ground target outside its ray bounds. It remains an uncertainty
blocker when its bounds precede the nearest verified target. No additional
vertex arrays are read and no budget is raised. Unsupported deformed/custom
geometry remains fail-closed. Exact previous sampler bytes expose the ordinary
checked observer upgrade; the upgrade preserves authored source and refuses
conflicting draft edits. See the ray-local static mesh budget ADR.
